resources.string: Vesistant is an remote voice assistant made for the students of V.E.S Institute of Technology.
This AI powered tool acts as an 24/7 assistant for students to ask for college related queries. Students can ask queries related to admissions, departments, societies, placements, etc.
The Vesistant Application closes the gap between the university and the students by automating repetitive queries and helps students to stay up-to-date.
